svg.title: Nine of the ten largest cross-border links led to the US
svg.desc: Arrows run from contributor economy to GitHub-assigned destination. Weight adds public pushes and opened pull requests, not workers or payments. Domestic and EU-aggregate links are excluded. Country links do not establish residence or software ownership. Flat Plate Carrée projection, north up, including Antarctica. Country/economy symbols use representative geographic anchors, not individual activity locations. Land area is not the data measure. Curved links are schematic connections, not travel routes or geodesics.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes. Projection: Plate Carree (equirectangular; central meridian 0; standard parallel 0). Boundary files and anchor coordinates are retained in geography/.

g.data-projection: Plate Carree (equirectangular; central meridian 0; standard parallel 0)
